# @n3wth/ui

> Atomic design system for React applications. Flat, minimal, iOS-inspired components built on Tailwind CSS 4 and Astryx primitives.

## Overview

@n3wth/ui is an open-source React component library following atomic design principles. It provides a flat, minimal aesthetic with no shadows or heavy effects—just clean glassmorphism and precise typography.

- **npm**: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@n3wth/ui
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/n3wth/ui
- **Documentation**: https://ui.n3wth.com

## Installation

```bash
npm install @n3wth/ui
```

```tsx
import { Button, Card, Hero } from '@n3wth/ui'
import '@n3wth/ui/styles'
```

## Components

### Atoms
Button, Badge, Input, Textarea, Label, Icon, Avatar, AnimatedText, Character, CodeBlock, HamburgerIcon, NoiseOverlay, Progress, ScrollIndicator, Separator, Shape, Skeleton, SpeechBubble, Switch, Tooltip

### Molecules
Card, Accordion, CommandBox, CompositeShape, Dropdown, ErrorBoundary, MobileDrawer, Modal, NavLink, Tabs, ThemeToggle, Toast

### Organisms
Nav, Hero, Section, Footer

### Hooks
useTheme, useMediaQuery, useKeyboardShortcuts, useScrollReveal, useReducedMotion, useToast, useCountUp, useButtonPulse, usePageTransition, useStaggerList, useTextReveal

## Design Tokens

- **Typography**: `font-display` (Mona Sans), `font-sans` (Geist Sans)
- **Glass effects**: `.glass-card`, `.glass-pill`, `.glass-nav`
- **Colors**: Semantic tokens including `bg`, `bg-secondary`, `sage`, `coral`, `gold`, `mint`

## Built With

- React 18/19
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS 4
- Astryx primitives (@astryxdesign/core)

## Related Resources

- Astryx Design System: https://kit.n3wth.com
- Comparison guide: https://garden.n3wth.com/astryx-vs-shadcn-vs-angular-material
